::: {.column width="60%"}
I am a Ph.D. Candidate in Public Administration at the University of Illinois Chicago and hold a Ph.D. in Public Policy from CIDE. My research examines the ways local governments govern in metropolitan systems, where authority is divided across multiple jurisdictions but problems are shared.

I study intergovernmental collaboration as an institutional response to political fragmentation, using a networks lens to examine how governments collaborate under these conditions, how collaboration becomes institutionalized, and what these choices mean for management, service delivery, and regional outcomes.
